subject: reasoning
question:
Which letter-cluster will replace the question mark (?) to complete the given series?

PBXJ, TFJX, ?, BNJX, FRXJ
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4a5b7cf84abd4e09a63d504f404b2035f579e6a3a005e11d54e3ca50bd42a099.png] 

Logic :

 
• First letter → (4) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Second letter → (4) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Third letter → (14) is subtracted from the position value according to English alphabetic series.
 
• Fourth letter → (4) is added to the position value according to English alphabetic series.

So,

 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9365cbe473a3e6407eff764923d649b5b6344fcb177e0cd84675fe92d67cc8ba.png] 

​Hence, "**XJXJ**" is the correct answer.
